entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I, um, I need to return something. A VeloBand tracker. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and the order number?
Yes, it's for Sarah Jenkins, order number is... uh, 774-B-91. I think. It's all been a bit much lately.

No problem at all, Sarah. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered about 28 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's not broken. It's just... my husband was supposed to use it. But we had an emergency and he ended up in the hospital. He needs surgery, and he won't be able to use this for months, if ever.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope he has a speedy recovery. I can understand why this would be the last thing on your mind.

Thank you. And on top of his surgery, my son's deployment got moved up, so it's just been one thing after another. I saw something online about 10 days or 20 days and I got worried. Can't you just help me? I don't understand these policies.
Of course, Sarah. Let me take the worry off your plate. I just need to check our official policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I've checked our knowledge base, and you have nothing to worry about. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Wait, 10 days? Really? Are you sure?

Yes, absolutely. Since you received it 28 days ago, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and email you a pre-paid return label right now. Once we receive the item, you'll get a full refund.
Oh, wow. That's... that's such a relief. After everything with the hospital, this is one less thing to worry about. Thank you so much, Charlie.
You're very welcome, Sarah. It's the least we can do. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband all the best.
